title: Socio-Economic Impact Assessment of Dzud 2023-2024: Dzud Resilience Strategy Policy Recommendations
organization: UNDP Mongolia, in collaboration with the Government of Mongolia and partner agencies
temporal_coverage: Assesses the 2023-2024 dzud; the PDF cover says September 2024 and the UNDP publication page is dated 27 May 2025. Field survey data were collected in 2024; the risk map cited is dated 20 December 2023.
methodology: Uses NEMA/NAMEM records, field visits and ADAPT household survey.
limitations: Survey covers four aimags; conflict observations are not armed-conflict estimates.

title: 2024 Dzud Early Action and Response Plan
organization: United Nations Resident Coordinator's Office and Humanitarian Country Team, Mongolia
temporal_coverage: Plan issued 19 February 2024 for the December 2023-May 2024 dzud response; targeting criteria and actions refer to that event period.
methodology: HCT plan synthesizes government dzud-risk classifications and sector response inputs.
limitations: Plan targets and reported early actions are not a final coverage audit.

title: Mongolia Humanitarian Situation Report No. 4 (Dzud), 30 April 2024
temporal_coverage: Situation report dated 30 April 2024; impact figures cover the November 2023-April 2024 dzud, with programme outputs stated through 25 April 2024.
methodology: UNICEF situation report compiles needs data and agency-reported programme results.
limitations: Snapshot is dated 30 April 2024; output counts are time-bound and not outcome evaluations.

title: World Bank Report Highlights Importance of Social Protection Response in Strengthening Mongolian Households' Resilience to Climate and Economic Shocks
temporal_coverage: World Bank press release dated 27 May 2025 summarizing a report on adaptive social protection and herder resilience.
methodology: Publisher summary of a World Bank study of adaptive social protection.
limitations: Full report link did not open; evidence is limited to the official summary.
